from pathlib import Path
import json
record=json.loads(Path("package/B1/logs/006-bridge-issue.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
issue=json.loads(record["stdout"])
Path("package/B1/native/spawn-arguments.json").write_text(json.dumps(issue["spawn_arguments"],ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
# Retain the issue-derived status query too, as its own exact argument object.
Path("package/B1/native/host-status-query.json").write_text(json.dumps(issue["host_status_query"],ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
